1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

* **[Biotech]** **Manganese links to Akt signaling** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.02.746017)
  * Hepatocyte manganese concentrations act as a physiological cofactor for Akt, enhancing its catalytic efficiency and acting additively with insulin.
  * Hepatic manganese fluctuates via carbohydrate-dependent transcriptional regulation of the efflux transporter Slc30a10, providing a PI3K-independent mechanism for Akt regulation.

* **[Biotech]** **CADD522 demonstrates bone and metabolic efficacy** [Nature Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/s44386-026-00076-z)
  * The RUNX2 inhibitor CADD522 improved bone microarchitecture and lipid metabolism in models of post-menopausal bone loss.

* **Multi-omic liquid biopsies and biomarker profiling** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.11.12.620657)
  * Profiling of particles in exhaled air (PExA) identified extracellular vesicle-associated proteins and 39 mature miRNAs, including miRNA-125b and let-7 family members, offering a non-invasive approach for distal lung biomarker discovery.
  * A separate dual proteomics analysis of paired cerebrospinal fluid and plasma using SomaScan 11K and NULISAseq CNS panels identified 269 and 18 cross-biofluid correlations, highlighting compartmental biology in neurodegeneration.

* **Glucocorticoid disruption and insulin dynamics** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.03.730005)
  * Flattening daily glucocorticoid rhythms in mice produced rapid hyperinsulinaemia with normal glucose, driven by enhanced beta cell glucose responsiveness and reduced hepatic insulin clearance.
  * Adult-inducible beta cell glucocorticoid receptor knockout reduced cumulative circulating insulin exposure by ~40% (p < 0.001) and worsened glycemic control.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

* **Neoadjuvant cetuximab and tislelizumab in OSCC** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42702927)
  * Results from a pilot clinical trial evaluating cetuximab combined with tislelizumab as neoadjuvant therapy for locally advanced oral squamous cell carcinoma.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

* **[Big Pharma]** **Novo Nordisk halts cardiovascular inflammation trials** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/07/novo-nordisk-heart-studies-inflammation-ziltivekimab/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Novo Nordisk has terminated two clinical trials investigating the anti-inflammatory drug ziltivekimab for cardiovascular health improvement, dealing a setback to anti-inflammatory cardiovascular therapeutic strategies.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

* **[Big Pharma]** **Camizetrant accelerated approval speculation** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2096923398735552519)
  * Market commentary via ApexOnco questions whether AstraZeneca's camizetrant could be positioned for an accelerated regulatory approval pathway.

5. **Business & Strategy**

* **Data leakage inflates biomarker performance** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.02.26362037)
  * Evaluation of proteomic pipelines demonstrates widespread susceptibility to data leakage, generating inflated performance estimates, poor generalization, and excess false positives. Two new detection tools are introduced for code and manuscript review.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

* **African clinical trial oversight initiatives** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04645-7)
  * An analysis of the TRACE initiative highlights strategies for strengthening clinical trial ethics and regulatory oversight frameworks across Africa.

* **Public health leadership controversy in Michigan** [Science-Based Medicine](https://sciencebasedmedicine.org/dr-remington-nevin-michigans-rfk-jr-or-the-new-dr-joseph-ladapo-of-michigan/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=dr-remington-nevin-michigans-rfk-jr-or-the-new-dr-joseph-ladapo-of-michigan)
  * Commentary examines the appointment of Dr. Remington Nevin as a county health director in Michigan amidst concerns regarding public health policy alignment.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [Berberine: A Powerful New Metabolic Mechanism Discovered!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dmS29b3g1l0) -- Physionic
        - Analyzes metabolic mechanisms of berberine and metformin in the management of type 2 diabetes.
        - Cites research indicating metformin works by inhibiting mitochondrial complex I specifically within the intestinal epithelium to enhance glycemic control.
        - Highlights clinical evidence showing metformin treatment significantly increases intestinal glucose uptake in type 2 diabetes patients.
        - Evaluates the clinical efficacy and mechanisms of berberine as a metabolic treatment option.
    - [Blood pressure: how to measure, manage, and treat high blood pressure (AMA #48 rebroadcast)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n42zMaH2Jgc) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Identifies high blood pressure as one of the three primary causes of atherosclerosis, alongside elevated apoB levels and smoking.
        - Outlines accurate blood pressure measurement techniques, diagnostic criteria, and the clinical management of patients in the high-normal range.
        - Explores the pathological effects of hypertension on cardiovascular function, brain health, and kidney function, as well as the risks of hypotension.
        - Evaluates non-pharmacological interventions—including weight loss, exercise, sodium restriction, sleep optimization, and improving insulin resistance—alongside pharmacological treatments.
- Pure Science
    - [The Most Dangerous Escalator In Europe](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/oR94cicO7xM) -- Veritasium
        - Recounts a 2018 incident in Rome where a metro escalator carrying football fans suffered a sudden mechanical failure.
        - Describes how an initial fault triggered a sequential cascade of multiple built-in safety systems.
        - Investigates the ultimate breakdown of the final safety line that led to the catastrophic failure of the escalator.
